title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Cook has expressed her readiness to take action regarding interest rate hikes as a measure to combat inflation. Recently, she was part of a 9-3 majority that decided to maintain the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate within the range of 3.5% to 3.75%. This decision reflects ongoing concerns about inflationary pressures and the need for careful monetary policy adjustments. Cook's comments indicate a proactive stance in addressing economic challenges. Her willingness to act underscores the Fed's commitment to managing inflation effectively.
